approval_field_interpretation.algorithm: Remove parenthesized qualifiers and nonletters from the extracted headword; all-uppercase letters yield approved, other letters yield not-approved, and no letters yield unknown.
approval_field_interpretation.limitation: Retained verbatim as raw mechanical source status only; not an IT disposition, verified typography, or blanket permission for any sense.

sequence.selection: Source dictionary global rows 921..960, without filtering by source status, domain, warnings, or disposition.
sequence.order_basis: pdf_page ascending, then numeric row suffix of the stable entry ID; extractor assigns suffixes from positioned row anchors in page order.

interpretation.disposition_scope: Each disposition applies only to the stated sense and scope, and remains a draft editorial proposal. Allowed and restricted do not constitute vocabulary approval.
interpretation.allowed: Proposed for the stated sense, subject to editorial review.
interpretation.restricted: Proposed only for the explicitly stated sense and contextual constraints.
interpretation.prohibited: Proposed exclusion of the stated prose use; choose a contextually correct alternative.
interpretation.not-applicable: No general IT prose sense proposed for the source sense; this does not ban all specialist physical documentation.
interpretation.needs-review: Mechanical ambiguity prevents a settled decision; definitions and examples are provisional editorial proposals.
interpretation.alternatives: Original contextual expressions, not allocated term IDs or an assertion that each expression is globally approved; use only when it preserves the intended meaning.
interpretation.examples: All examples and explanations are original IT-STE editorial content. Positive examples may demonstrate a replacement rather than use a prohibited or inapplicable headword. Positive examples under needs-review are provisional.
interpretation.literal_boundary: No decision authorizes changing literal code, API fields, protocol tokens, UI labels, citations, or proper names. No unknown proper noun is approved by this batch.
interpretation.source_content_limit: Only short headwords, raw status, locators, and extraction warnings are retained from source rows; source definitions, alternatives, and examples are not reproduced.
